csv_project_name: Consultant for Becker County Airport - Detroit Lakes
csv_scope_of_work: The Detroit Lakes - Becker County Airport Commission is requesting Statements of Qualifications from interested and qualified Aviation Consultants for Professional On-Call Airport Consulting Services at the Detroit Lakes / Becker County Airport Wething Field for the next five (5) years. Professional planning, environmental, engineering, technical, and advisory services are needed and included in this solicitation for projects identified in the Airport s Capital Improvement Program (CIP). Projects may include airport planning, environmental documentation, wildlife studies, wetland mitigation, airside/landside design plans and specifications, airport zoning, land acquisition, construction administration, airport building design, and AIP program management. A copy of the Airport s current CIP is available for review on request at City Administration Building. Consultants should be familiar with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and State of Minnesota aviation funding programs and requirements.
